observations: Torah #102 is a fragmentary teaching — Rebbe Nachman delivered a full torah to a visiting rav about Boaz and Rut, but R' Noson only received the two core bechina identifications (Rut = tefillah, Boaz = go'el) and the framing concept (sod semichat geulah l'tefillah). The dataset already captures both bechina edges. While the gap analysis identifies additional concepts from the source text (semichat geulah l'tefillah, David, shirot v'tishbachot), these would add at most 1-2 nodes to existing packages rather than forming an independent 3+ node domain. The second part of the torah (about the value of revealing dibbur to the world) is a separate topic with no bechina language. No new packages are warranted.
